# noderings_role (Data Source)

Looks up a role by name: a custom role or a built-in one (Owner, Administrator, Billing, Operator, Viewer).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noderings_role" "viewer" {
  name = "Viewer"
}

output "viewer_role_id" {
  value = data.noderings_role.viewer.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `builtin` (Boolean) Whether this is a built-in role.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Role ID.
- `permission_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the permissions the role grants.
